tools.name: pressure_drop
tools.description: Find where injection pressure is consumed along the flow path. Each reading is the CUMULATIVE peak pressure needed to fill through that section — an air shot gives the nozzle figure, then sprue, runner, gate and the full part — so the values ascend. Known sections: Nozzle, Sprue, Runner, Gate, Part.

tools.name: cosmetic_window
tools.description: Map which combinations of two process parameters produce a cosmetically acceptable part, and how much room surrounds the centre. tools.description: Find the shortest cooling time at which a dimension has stopped changing, and the cycle seconds that come off. Supply the drawing tolerance and the rule tightens to a tenth of it. Measure each part at a consistent interval after ejection — the part keeps moving.
